# ss-bento-item



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

One tile of an `ss-bento`: a cell that spans columns and rows. It draws
nothing of its own; what is inside (an `ss-card`, a chart, an image) does,
and is stretched to fill the cell.

## Properties

| Property  | Attribute  | Description                                                 | Type     | Default |
| --------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- |
| `colSpan` | `col-span` | Columns the tile spans, at most the columns in use.         | `number` | `1`     |
| `rowSpan` | `row-span` | Rows the tile spans; one when the bento is a single column. | `number` | `1`     |


## Slots

| Slot | Description         |
| ---- | ------------------- |
|      | The tile's content. |
